unit_cn: Unit 3 Food and Culture 食物与文化
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 3 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、食物与文化主题(中国饮食/八大菜系/食物与健康/世界美食/饮食习惯)、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The local cooking association holds a food festival every year.
words.example_cn: 当地烹饪协会每年都举办美食节。

words.example_en: She enjoys eating a warm steamed bun for breakfast.
words.example_cn: 她喜欢早餐吃一个热乎乎的馒头。

words.example_en: Hand-torn cabbage is a simple but tasty home dish.
words.example_cn: 手撕包菜是一道简单却美味的家常菜。

words.example_en: We had a quick lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.example_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅匆匆吃了午饭。

words.example_en: Fresh vegetables are usually low in calories.
words.example_cn: 新鲜蔬菜通常热量很低。

words.example_en: We just ate whatever was left in the university canteen.
words.example_cn: 我们只吃了大学食堂里剩下的东西。

words.example_en: A balanced diet includes different categories of fresh food.
words.example_cn: 均衡的饮食包含不同类别的新鲜食物。

words.example_en: The chef began filling our table with the best food we had ever eaten.
words.example_cn: 主厨开始把我们吃过最好的菜摆满餐桌。

words.example_en: People who chew too quickly often end up eating too much.
words.example_cn: 嚼得太快的人往往吃得过多。

words.example_en: Steamed fish head covered with chillies is a famous Hunan dish.
words.example_cn: 剁椒鱼头是一道有名的湖南菜。

words.example_en: A traditional Western dinner can consist of soup, a main course, and dessert.
words.example_cn: 传统西餐可以由汤、主菜和甜点组成。

words.meaning_cn: 一致的;连续的;始终如一的
words.example_en: Consistent eating habits are better for our health.
words.example_cn: 始终如一的饮食习惯更有益健康。

words.example_en: You can keep healthy by consuming different fresh foods.
words.example_cn: 多吃不同的新鲜食物有助于保持健康。

words.example_en: Chinese cuisine is famous all over the world.
words.example_cn: 中国菜肴闻名于世。

words.example_en: Dairy products provide the protein we need for strong bones.
words.example_cn: 乳制品提供我们强健骨骼所需的蛋白质。

words.example_en: If you want to be healthy, you have to cut down on desserts.
words.example_cn: 想要健康,你得少吃甜点。

words.example_en: The chef rolled the dough thin before making the buns.
words.example_cn: 厨师把面团擀薄,然后做包子。

words.example_en: Guangdong is known for its elegant dim sum.
words.example_cn: 广东以其精美的点心而著称。

words.example_en: The stewed noodles in Henan have an exceptional flavour.
words.example_cn: 河南的烩面有着特别的风味。

words.example_en: Fruit and vegetables are full of vitamins and fibre.
words.example_cn: 水果和蔬菜富含维生素和纤维。

words.meaning_cn: 根本的;基础的;基本规律
words.example_en: A fundamental key to healthy eating is to eat slowly.
words.example_cn: 健康饮食的一个根本要点是吃得慢一些。

words.example_en: He added some garlic to make the dish more tasty.
words.example_cn: 他加了些蒜,让这道菜更香。

words.example_en: She put a slice of ham between two buns.
words.example_cn: 她在两块小面包之间夹了一片火腿。

words.example_en: The ideal diet is a balanced one, without too much of any one thing.
words.example_cn: 理想的饮食是均衡的,任何一样都不过量。

words.example_en: Italy and Greece are famous for olives, figs, and other ingredients.
words.example_cn: 意大利和希腊以橄榄、无花果等食材而闻名。

words.example_en: Eating too much junk food is bad for your health.
words.example_cn: 吃太多垃圾食品对健康有害。

words.example_en: Their traditional food is roasted meat, such as lamb kebab.
words.example_cn: 他们的传统食物是烤肉,比如烤羊肉串。

words.phrase_en: Are you ready to order, madam?
words.example_en: Are you ready to order, madam? asked the polite waiter.
words.example_cn: 礼貌的服务员问道:女士,您准备好点菜了吗?

words.example_en: She keeps her consumption of sweets down to a minimum.
words.example_cn: 她把甜食的摄入降到了最低限度。

words.example_en: As with everything in life, moderation is key to healthy eating.
words.example_cn: 正如生活中的一切,适度是健康饮食的关键。

words.example_en: It is better to eat a modest amount of food at each meal.
words.example_cn: 每餐吃适量的食物会更好。

words.example_en: People in Greece often cook their food with olive oil.
words.example_cn: 希腊人常用橄榄油来烹饪食物。

words.example_en: The pancake rolls were stuffed with sliced green onions.
words.example_cn: 煎饼卷里塞满了切好的大葱。

words.example_en: Overall, I think I have fairly healthy eating habits.
words.example_cn: 总体上,我觉得自己的饮食习惯还算健康。

words.example_en: The chicken was flavoured with hot red peppers.
words.example_cn: 这道鸡肉用辣红椒调了味。

words.example_en: We had the pleasure of tasting Sichuan peppercorns for the first time.
words.example_cn: 我们有幸第一次品尝了四川花椒。

words.example_en: Red braised pork is one of the most famous Chinese dishes.
words.example_cn: 红烧肉是最有名的中国菜之一。

words.example_en: Prior to coming to China, I had only tried Chinese food in America.
words.example_cn: 来中国之前,我只在美国吃过中餐。

words.example_en: Processed foods often have higher quantities of sugar and salt.
words.example_cn: 加工食品往往含有更高数量的糖和盐。

words.example_en: This is probably not an authentic Chinese recipe.
words.example_cn: 这大概并不是一道地道的中国菜谱。

words.example_en: Sugar harms health regardless of how healthy the rest of your diet is.
words.example_cn: 无论你饮食的其余部分多健康,糖都会损害健康。

words.example_en: She sliced off a piece of sausage for her dinner.
words.example_cn: 她切下一块香肠作为晚餐。

words.example_en: He sliced the green onions before adding them to the dish.
words.example_cn: 他把大葱切成片,然后加进菜里。

words.example_en: Hunan cuisine is somewhat different from Sichuan cuisine.
words.example_cn: 湖南菜与四川菜略有不同。

words.example_en: As the person to bring home the bacon, he needs a stable job.
words.example_cn: 作为养家糊口的人,他需要一份稳定的工作。

words.example_en: Do those who like spicy food tend to have a hot temper?
words.example_cn: 喜欢吃辣的人是不是更容易脾气暴躁?

words.example_en: There is no one trick to healthy eating.
words.example_cn: 健康饮食没有什么单一的诀窍。

words.example_en: A vegetarian eats no meat and prefers vegetables and beans.
words.example_cn: 素食者不吃肉,更喜欢蔬菜和豆类。

words.example_en: My favourite dish was boiled dumplings served with vinegar.
words.example_cn: 我最爱的菜是蘸醋吃的水煮饺子。

words.example_en: Fresh fruit is full of vitamins and good for you.
words.example_cn: 新鲜水果富含维生素,对你有益。
